Yellow_Leaf shows golden-yellow coloration on the entire leaf — quite similar to the straw-colored bleaching in the test image. Let me check one more candidate — Grassy_Shoot.

The Grassy_Shoot reference is a near-perfect match to the test image. Both show:

- Mix of green and straw/pale-bleached leaves
- Leaves drooping outward with the same plant architecture
- Soil/field background with the same growth habit

This is clearly **Grassy_Shoot** disease (caused by phytoplasma), characterized by the proliferation of many thin grass-like shoots with pale straw coloration — exactly what is seen in the test image. The reddish discoloration at the stem base is also consistent with phytoplasma infection in sugarcane.
